verdicts.reason: The layouts are identical. Both shrink the can into a small cluster and leave a large dead gap between the can and the headline, and the peach circle runs under the CTA. A keeps the headline, the SOLSTICE wordmark and the subcopy at readable sizes, though its subcopy line nearly reaches the canvas edges. B shrinks the subcopy to tiny text with weak contrast and the wordmark to a small size, so hierarchy and legibility are worse.
